title: The Chinese Video Game Industry
author_or_organization: Feng Chen; Ken S. McAllister; Judd Ethan Ruggill (eds.)
publication_or_publisher: Palgrave Macmillan, Palgrave Games in Context
used_for: Industry context; seven forces shaping Chinese game industry, including state power, development model, mobile, exports and traditional cultural resources.
limitations: Provides broad industry framing, not a prescriptive studio workflow.

title: Introduction
author_or_organization: Feng Chen; Ken S. McAllister; Judd Ethan Ruggill
publication_or_publisher: Chapter in The Chinese Video Game Industry, Palgrave Macmillan
used_for: Analytical frame separating state, development model, market, mobile, exports, cultural resources and esports.
limitations: Macro-level introduction rather than a study of a single production pipeline.

title: From copycat to magical monkey: Understanding the video game development culture in China
author_or_organization: Xiao Lu; Hong Yu Liu
publication_or_publisher: European Journal of Cultural Studies, online first; print issue 29(1), 2026
used_for: Creativity–commercial imperative tension; developer-centred account of imitation, profitability, labour and skill-development pressures.
limitations: Does not publish a reusable narrative-production SOP; its conclusions should not be generalized to every studio or genre.

title: Games With a Continuum: Globalization, Regionalization, and the Nation-State in the Development of China’s Online Game Industry
author_or_organization: Qiaolei Jiang; Anthony Y. H. Fung
evidence_level: A—peer-reviewed; interviews, ethnography and archival analysis
used_for: Historical institutional context; how state, regional and global forces enter online-game design, production and operation.
limitations: Fieldwork predates the recent console/AAA and current AIGC wave.

title: Internationalization and Post-Orientalism: The Evolution of the Guochao of Contemporary Chinese Video Games
author_or_organization: Degang Kong
publication_or_publisher: Chapter in The Chinese Video Game Industry, Palgrave Macmillan
used_for: Guochao, localization/internationalization and the historical evolution of wuxia/xianxia/AAA cultural positioning.
limitations: Cultural-historical analysis; no direct measurement of contemporary team practices.

title: Competition, Emotion, and Socialization: A Study on the In-Game Purchase Mechanism and Player Motivation in Onmyoji
author_or_organization: Shule Cao; Xinyi Xu
publication_or_publisher: Chapter in The Chinese Video Game Industry, Palgrave Macmillan
evidence_level: A—mixed-method game analysis, observation and interviews
used_for: Caution that character/narrative design in service games is entangled with emotion, sociality and monetization rather than being an isolated writing function.
limitations: Single-game case study; not a direct production-process observation.

title: Cultural Heritage and Chinese Digital Games
author_or_organization: Tiziano M. T. (article record at Brill)
used_for: How heritage appears in visual aesthetics, narrative and gameplay; warning against treating culture as a mere surface layer.
limitations: Textual/cultural analysis, not a field study of studios.

title: Cultivation games and cosmotechnics: Reimagining Sinofuturism in Chinese cultivation narratives
author_or_organization: Morgan Yu Hao
used_for: Design principle that cosmology can be embodied in progression rules and player actions, not only in art or text.
limitations: Analyses games as texts; does not document development teams.

title: Covertly Using Generative AI in China’s Gaming Industry
author_or_organization: Authors listed in DiGRA Digital Library record
evidence_level: A/B—qualitative practitioner interviews and policy review
used_for: Emerging AIGC use across planning, production and distribution; risks of culturally inaccurate output for Chinese gardens, xia and mythology.
limitations: Fast-changing topic; interview identities are anonymized and practices may be underreported.

title: 出版国产网络游戏作品审批
author_or_organization: 国家新闻出版署 (National Press and Publication Administration)
used_for: Domestic online-game approval requirements: full Chinese script, keyword library, screenshots, review account, anti-addiction information, demo and publishing review report; 80 working-day stated period.
limitations: Applies to the specified publication/approval process, not every game distribution scenario; not a creative-design manual.

title: 网络出版服务管理规定
author_or_organization: 国家新闻出版广电总局、工业和信息化部 (hosted by Cyberspace Administration of China)
publication_or_publisher: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室
used_for: Legal basis for pre-publication approval, major-topic filing and content removal/reporting obligations of online publishing services.
limitations: Legal source; consult qualified Chinese counsel for current application and product-specific advice.

title: 漫谈世界观叙事设计中的工具链
author_or_organization: Joy, 腾讯互娱游戏策划
evidence_level: B—named practitioner workflow; explicitly presented as personal experience
used_for: Four-module narrative toolchain; concept, writing, presentation and coordination; knowledge base, live documentation, editors, review lists and asset/narrative presentation taxonomy.
limitations: Author expressly says the division is personal experience, principally MMO/mobile-oriented, not a universal standard.

title: 理性与感性的碰撞：解析游戏叙事的概念、价值与方法
author_or_organization: Lucia, 腾讯游戏策划
used_for: TMMASC six-step framework: target affect, connect mechanics, marshal materials, adjust micro-variables, choose macro structure and select cost-effective delivery; iteration and resource prioritization.
limitations: A pedagogic framework and author’s synthesis, not a validated scientific standard.

title: IP建设：角色设计与世界观构建
author_or_organization: 乌鸦 / Sydney, 古龙IP总架构师・游戏策划
used_for: IP dimensions (image, character, world, story), character layers, cultural value and long-life/UGC logic.
limitations: Prescriptive practitioner lesson rather than comparative research.

title: 我和腾讯光子的专家，聊了聊中国游戏行业最大的一块短板
author_or_organization: 游戏葡萄 / 腾讯光子叙事设计专家 Lucia interview
used_for: For original IP, narrative involvement from idea stage; demo produces a world frame plus narrative slice; game and narrative designers co-design emotional curve and resource peaks.
limitations: Interview testimony from one Tencent studio group; it reports a practice, not an industry census.

title: 网易文案策划必修课：从剧情、世界观到情节的具体创作
author_or_organization: 网易游戏学院 / 网易游学
publication_or_publisher: GameRes (states original source: NetEase internal knowledge platform / 2021 teaching material)
source_type: corporate training material republished by industry media
used_for: Narrative work packages: script, character/scenery/action/VFX/cinematic requirements, task editor; worldview modules and iterative testing of in-engine content.
limitations: Educational material; report treats it as a documented workflow exemplar, not proof of every NetEase project’s procedure.

title: 整理｜网易游戏美术经理：时尚与传统——《阴阳师》角色的“设计感”
author_or_organization: 网易游戏美术经理 万蒙雨（N.Game 2021 presentation, republished）
used_for: Onmyoji example of locking theme keywords early and iterating demo art while preserving agreed direction; culture + story as character-design inputs.
limitations: One art-management case and secondary transcript.

title: 原神制作组致玩家的一封信
author_or_organization: 《原神》制作组 / 米哈游
used_for: Pre-project prototypes, explicit learning references, challenge of coordinating nearly 300 staff, closed-beta feedback collection and iterative modification; multi-year world-release plan.
limitations: Public-facing project communication; naturally selective and not an independent audit.

title: 米哈游CEO蔡浩宇GDC演讲：《原神》如何打造动人的开放世界？
author_or_organization: GameRes reporting on Cai Haoyu’s GDC 2021 presentation
used_for: Genshin character pipeline: world/location setting → team ideation/review → concept art → 3D model → movement/gameplay; character-centred parallel narrative.
limitations: Secondary report of a conference presentation; not a full official transcript.

title: 成为全球收入第一手游后，我们和米哈游聊了聊他们心目中的《原神》
author_or_organization: GameRes interview with miHoYo
used_for: Long-range framework (seven cities; map, main and side story planned) plus ongoing adjustment based on community observation and in-game behavior data.
limitations: Promotional/retrospective interview; details are not independently audited.

title: 解码中国游戏开发：决策、创作与表达——TipsWorks工作室主创访谈实录
author_or_organization: 李志鹏; 李典峰; TipsWorks creators
publication_or_publisher: 《数字出版研究》深度访谈专题 (Tencent News host)
used_for: Documented alternative order: start with characters, then construct world; retain deep world framework while focusing the product on particular small-scale perspectives.
limitations: A single studio’s creative philosophy, not a general rule.

title: 对话中国之星总监与制作人：挖掘本土精英 助推新势力走向世界
author_or_organization: 中国之星计划制作人及索尼互动娱乐（上海）制作总监 interviews
used_for: External milestone review of R&D process, technical/design documents and versions; detailed feedback and project-management/agile training.
limitations: Incubation-program account; selected projects and mentoring conditions are not typical of all teams.

title: IGN 中国专访育碧成都《刺客信条：影》制作人 & 总监
author_or_organization: IGN China interview with Ubisoft Chengdu producer/director
used_for: Historical content workflow example: research references for gameplay/story are reviewed by internal team and historians before production.
limitations: Ubisoft is a multinational case in Chengdu and its approval process should not be assumed to represent domestic Chinese studios.

title: 腾讯光子《和平精英》策划总监带你探究游戏制作过程
author_or_organization: 腾讯光子策划总监 (reported by GameRes)
used_for: Five-stage product cycle (research, prototype, full production, test/modify, launch); roles including literary design; player research, closed/open test and post-launch feedback loop.
limitations: A practitioner’s simplified explanatory model, not a detailed project postmortem.

title: 网易制作人摊牌了：烧掉10亿，再返10亿，天崩开局，死中求活
author_or_organization: 游戏葡萄 interview with NetEase producer V
used_for: Feature-team/matrix organisation for large-scale rework; content prioritisation and treating narrative chapters as seasonal units.
limitations: High-profile turnaround narrative; claims are not independently verified and are not a general operating prescription.

title: 游戏开发最佳实践：兼顾巨细，如何用飞书项目管理游戏开发全流程
author_or_organization: 飞书项目
used_for: Illustrative cadence hierarchy: annual milestones, versions, weekly or biweekly iterations, requirements/module visibility and notification design.
limitations: Marketing/template material; cadence must not be treated as industry average or empirical benchmark.

title: 罗聪翼：使用禅道做游戏开发项目管理的敏捷实践分享
author_or_organization: 罗聪翼 / 禅道软件
used_for: Illustrative agile mechanics: milestone/release, 2-week sprint, version–requirement–test-case–bug traceability and release-candidate stabilization.
limitations: Older, vendor-hosted case; technology and organisational practice may have changed.

title: Localizing Chinese games for Southeast Asian markets: A multidimensional perspective
author_or_organization: Zhiwei Wu; Zhuojia Chen
publication_or_publisher: The Journal of Internationalization and Localization, 7(1–2), 49–68
jurisdiction: Chinese games exported to Southeast Asia
used_for: Localization needs an early product concern; documents post-gold versus deep-localization trade-offs and locale plurality.
limitations: Focuses on Southeast Asia, not domestic China nor every global market.

title: 2025年中国游戏产业报告（正式发布）
author_or_organization: 中国音像与数字出版协会游戏出版工作委员会 / 游戏工委
used_for: Contemporary market context: mobile predominance, multi-platform growth, long-running operations and product-quality emphasis.
limitations: Industry macro statistics and interpretation, not an observational study of narrative-development teams.

title: 黑神话：悟空制作人接受观网专访：用世界级的水准，讲一个中国故事
author_or_organization: 冯骥 / 游戏科学 interview
publication_or_publisher: 澎湃新闻（转载观察者网专访）
used_for: Portfolio risk management: revenue-bearing mobile work and gradual team-building preceded a high-risk premium project; world as multi-product IP rather than one isolated work.
limitations: Early-stage interview; it does not describe full later production or establish an industry norm.

title: 黑神话：悟空与中国传统文化叙事的游戏化转化（PDF issue/article record）
author_or_organization: 北京工业大学学报（社会科学版） article record
publication_or_publisher: 北京工业大学学报（社会科学版）
used_for: Analytical discussion of Black Myth’s cultural/narrative integration, including environmental and codex-like storytelling.
limitations: Text-focused scholarship; do not infer internal production workflow unless independently documented.

title: 电子游戏中空间叙事学的结构划分与设计策略
author_or_organization: Article authors listed by 北京邮电大学学报（社会科学版）
publication_or_publisher: 北京邮电大学学报（社会科学版）
used_for: Spatial narrative vocabulary and a reminder to design conceptual, media, content, player and meaning spaces together.
limitations: A proposed analytic framework, not a measured Chinese-studio pipeline.

title: 探索中国游戏生产：以《黑神话：悟空》为例
author_or_organization: Hugh Davies
used_for: Questions raised by premium Chinese production: funding/independence, regulation, historical content and production contradictions.
limitations: Conference paper; use for research framing, not for unverified production facts.
